{{Top|leg}}
A '''vital signs monitor''' was a medical device used to monitor an individual's vital signs. It was a flexible device, roughly the size of a large [[credcoin]] and had a translucent red [[flexiplast]] for its surface. The monitor adhered to the skin and displayed the patient's heartbeat as a pulsing glow.<ref name="MK">''[[X-Wing: Mercy Kill]]''</ref>

In [[44 ABY]],<ref name="TERC">''[[The Essential Reader's Companion]]'' dates the events of ''[[X-Wing: Mercy Kill]]'' to [[44 ABY]].</ref> [[Drikall Bessarah]], acting as the [[Medic/Legends|medic]] for the [[Galactic Federation of Free Alliances|Galactic Alliance]] [[Commando/Legends|commando]] unit [[Wraith Squadron]], attached a field-grade vital signs monitor to the neck of his fellow Wraith [[Bhindi Drayson]] to monitor her heartbeat after she was wounded during the [[Siege of Mount Lyss Meteorological station |siege]] of the [[Mount Lyss Meteorological Station]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Vandor-3]].<ref name="MK" />
